ERIC: Eric, a fourteen-year-old English comprehensive-school boy in a 1985 uniform, navy blazer, white shirt, red and navy striped tie, grey shorts, grey knee socks, black shoes, short tousled ginger-brown hair, cheeky grin.
BOY: a twelve-year-old English schoolboy in a 1985 uniform, navy blazer, white shirt, red and navy striped tie, grey shorts, grey knee socks, black shoes, neat short dark brown hair, ordinary friendly face.
GIRL: a twelve-year-old English schoolgirl in a 1985 uniform, royal-blue pinafore dress over a white blouse, white knee socks, black buckled shoes, shoulder-length brown hair held back with a blue hairband, friendly face.
SWOT: Einstein, a thin, pale fourteen-year-old English schoolboy, the class swot, round wire-rimmed glasses, neatly combed brown hair with a side parting, navy blazer over a green V-neck jumper, white shirt, striped tie, grey shorts, grey knee socks, black shoes, earnest expression.
BULLY: Angelface, a big heavy-set fourteen-year-old English schoolboy, the class bully, square jaw, scowl, short black hair, navy blazer straining at the shoulders, white shirt with the tie loosened, grey shorts, grey socks, scuffed black shoes.
TEARAWAY: Boy Wander, a wiry fourteen-year-old English schoolboy, the tearaway, untidy spiky blond hair, mischievous grin, navy blazer worn open, shirt untucked, tie askew, grey shorts, one grey sock fallen down, black shoes.
HEROINE: Hayley, a fourteen-year-old English schoolgirl, the heroine, long golden-blonde hair, kind pretty face, pink dress with a white collar, white socks, black shoes.
WACKER: Mr Wacker, the headmaster, a tall gaunt man in his sixties, severe lined face, thin white hair, black academic gown flowing over a black three-piece suit, white shirt, black tie, black mortarboard with a tassel, black polished shoes.
WITHIT: Mr Withit, the geography master, a man in his forties, dark full beard and dark hair, green corduroy jacket with elbow patches, brown waistcoat, red tie, dark green trousers, brown brogues.
ROCKITT: Mr Rockitt, the science master, a man in his fifties, grey receding hair, half-moon spectacles, white laboratory coat open over a dark blue suit, blue tie, dark trousers, black shoes.
CREAK: Mr Creak, the history master, a very old stooped man, bald on top with wispy white hair at the sides, brown tweed three-piece suit, maroon bow tie, brown trousers, brown shoes, walking slightly hunched forward.
TAKE: Miss Take, the headmistress of the girls' school, a stern woman in her fifties, brown hair in a tight bun, pearl necklace, long purple dress with a white collar and long sleeves, dark stockings, black court shoes.
ALBERT: Albert, the school caretaker, a stocky man in his sixties, grey stubble, grey hair under a brown flat cap, brown overall coat over a checked shirt, dark trousers, heavy black boots, a bunch of keys at his belt.
